description:
**dunst** is a lightweight and customizable notification daemon, running natively on your jailbroken device on the iosc Wayland compositor.

This is a real native arm64 binary cross-compiled for rootless iOS. dunst implements the freedesktop notification specification over D-Bus, so apps that post notifications get a clean on-screen popup rendered through Pango and Cairo.

- freedesktop notifications over D-Bus
- Native Wayland via the wlr layer-shell protocol
- Pango and Cairo rendering with full styling control
- Rules to filter, group, and route notifications

Built for iPadOS/iOS rootless (palera1n/Dopamine, `/var/jb`). Run it inside an Xios desktop session running the iosc compositor.

changelog.notes:
- First release: dunst 1.13.2 cross-compiled for rootless iOS
- Wayland notification daemon on the iosc compositor
